description:
Who shipped more today? Committed ranks you against your friends and teammates by GitHub Contributions.

Connect GitHub and your board fills in: you, the people you follow, and the members of your GitHub organizations. They don't need Committed to show up.

THE BOARD
• Everyone ranked by Contributions, the count behind the green squares on a GitHub profile.
• Switch the Window between Today, 7 days and 30 days.
• Chevrons show who moved today. Your summary shows how many Contributions it takes to pass the person ahead.
• Pull to refresh. While the app is open, the board refreshes about every 5 minutes.

LIVE RANK
Keep your rank in the Dynamic Island and on the Lock Screen, with the people just above and below you. Pick its Window in Settings.

WIDGETS
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets show your rank and the gap to the person ahead.
• The Committed Board widget lists the leaders. It's made for StandBy.

SHARE BOARD
Share the board as an image of its widget, sized for a square post or a story.

PEOPLE
Search everyone on your board and hide anyone you don't want to race. Hidden people stay in People, so you can show them again. Hiding someone doesn't change who you follow on GitHub.

LEADERBOARD NOTIFICATIONS
Get a notification when you pass someone, or when someone passes you.

TRY A SAMPLE BOARD
Look around before you connect. The Sample board runs the whole app on built-in sample data, with no GitHub account.

WHAT GITHUB ACCESS IT NEEDS
• Connect GitHub uses GitHub's device flow: you approve a code on github.com.
• Committed asks for read-only access to your profile, who you follow and your organizations (read:user and read:org).
• It never asks for repository access or reads your code.
• Your GitHub token stays in your iPhone's Keychain and goes only to GitHub. There's no Committed account.
• Contributions come from each person's public contribution graph. Private contributions count only when that person turns them on in GitHub.

PRIVACY
• No ads, analytics or crash reporting.
• To keep Live rank current while the app is closed, the Committed relay receives your GitHub username, the usernames on your board, Live rank's Window, your time zone and push tokens. It never receives your GitHub token.

Committed is free. It compares activity counts, not code quality or work performance.
promotionalText: See who shipped more today. Committed ranks you against friends and teammates by GitHub Contributions, with Live rank in the Dynamic Island and widgets.
